# Crazy SEO Team

> Crazy SEO Team is an AI-focused SEO and digital growth platform for businesses that want stronger visibility across Google Search and AI-powered discovery.

## Search and content approach

Crazy SEO Team combines technical accessibility, useful people-first content, search intent, semantic coverage, entity relationships, internal linking, structured data, and clear answers. The goal is to make important business information understandable to both human visitors and modern search systems.

## AI search topics

AI Search Optimization covers the discoverability of important pages, entities, services and expertise in AI-assisted search.

Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) focuses on clear topical coverage, entity context, original information and trustworthy supporting evidence for generative search experiences.

Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) focuses on direct, useful answers, question-led content and clear information architecture.

LLM Optimization focuses on making brand, service and expertise information clear and machine-readable without keyword stuffing or misleading claims.

Content Engineering Services combine research, search intent, semantic coverage, internal linking, structured content and editorial quality.

Marketing Automation and AI Software connect content and SEO workflows with automation, analytics, AI agents and business systems.
